items.title: Entertainment and Media LLM Applications
items.description: LA's entertainment industry — the studios, streaming platforms, talent agencies, production companies, and the creative technology ecosystem — finds LLM value in content workflows that require scale and speed without sacrificing the creative judgment that distinguishes quality entertainment content. Script analysis assistants: RAG over existing scripts, story coverage, and production notes enabling development executives to quickly assess how a new submission compares to prior projects in terms of tone, genre, and commercial positioning. Production document intelligence: NLP over contracts, call sheets, budgets, and production reports — enabling production coordinators to query complex production documentation in natural language. Marketing and social content generation: LLM-powered content generation for social media, press releases, and marketing copy at the volume that streaming platforms and major studios require, with brand voice training that maintains studio identity. Subtitling and localization AI: GPT-4o's multilingual capability for generating subtitle translations and localization notes at faster-than-human speed for LA content destined for global distribution. Cost: $25,000–$85,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks.
items.label: Entertainment
